signal: FDA cleared the IND for QRL-201 in ALS, which lets QurAlis run its pivotal CONQUR trial in the U.S. It plans to start in the first half of 2027.
why_now: A pivotal U.S. study starting next year means trial vendors get picked in the next few months. Their extension dosing so far runs in Canada, the UK and the EU, so the U.S. setup is new work.
first_line: Congrats on the QRL-201 IND. With CONQUR planned for the first half of 2027, I figured EDC and study setup might be on your list right now.

signal: FDA cleared the IND for ITX-402. Intryx will run TIGER-1, a Phase 1/2a pediatric brain tumor trial, with enrollment targeted for early 2027.
why_now: Small Fort Worth company opening a new pediatric study in a few months. Data capture has to be set up and validated before the first patient enrolls.
first_line: Congrats on the ITX-402 clearance. With TIGER-1 enrollment targeted for early 2027, is the EDC for it already locked in?

signal: FDA cleared a Phase 1 trial of ER-100, its partial epigenetic reprogramming therapy, for glaucoma and NAION ("eye stroke").
why_now: Boston biotech heading into a first-in-human study. That first trial is where they choose the systems and partners they will likely keep for later phases.
first_line: Saw that ER-100 got cleared for Phase 1. First-in-human studies are where a clean data setup saves the most pain later.

signal: FDA sent written pre-IND feedback on TTI-109 for IBD. Tvardi says it will use it to finalize the IND, the last step before a first IBD trial.
why_now: They are planning the study right now, before vendors are locked. Earliest point to be in the room.
first_line: Saw the pre-IND feedback on TTI-109. Before the first IBD study is locked, would it help to see how we run EDC for small sponsors?

signal: FDA cleared the IND for EIK1006 in advanced prostate cancer. Eikon plans a Phase 1/2 study, ARGATE-001, with dosing expected to start in 2027.
why_now: New Phase 1/2 study with a 2027 start. Sites, data management and EDC all get decided before first dosing.
first_line: Congrats on the EIK1006 IND. With ARGATE-001 dosing expected in 2027, happy to show how we set up EDC for a Phase 1/2 like this.

signal: FDA cleared the IND for BD200, a bispecific ADC. A global Phase 1 in solid tumors is expected to begin in the coming weeks.
why_now: A global Phase 1 starting within weeks. If the U.S. sites still need a data setup, the window is right now.
first_line: Congrats on the BD200 clearance. With the Phase 1 starting in the next few weeks, is data capture for the U.S. sites sorted?

signal: FDA approved its IDE (on Oct. 2) to start B-SILENT 2, a pivotal trial of the BosSTENT for pulsatile tinnitus. First FDA-approved IDE trial of its kind.
why_now: A device company starting its pivotal study. Device sponsors need the same EDC and site work as drug sponsors, often with a much smaller team.
first_line: Congrats on the B-SILENT 2 IDE. Pivotal device trials with a lean team are exactly where we help most.

signal: FDA cleared the IND for privosegtor in acute MS relapses. The company calls it a new era for Oculis in neurology.
why_now: New therapeutic area means a new clinical program and new U.S. sites, outside the eye-care studies they already run.
first_line: Congrats on the privosegtor IND. Starting a neurology program from scratch is a good time to look at how the trial data gets captured.

signal: Raised $62 million (led by DCVC). The money goes toward clinical research, prototypes and FDA approvals for its robotic system for endovascular procedures.
why_now: Fresh money earmarked for clinical research. A medtech startup at this stage usually has no clinical data system yet.
first_line: Congrats on the $62 million. Since part of it is going to clinical research, happy to share how small teams run their first studies with us.

signal: Dosed the first participant in its Phase 2 trial of MAX-001, a non-opioid for acute pain. Privately held, based in Malvern, PA.
why_now: This study is already running, but MAX-001 is aimed at acute and chronic pain, so more studies are coming. Good time to be known before the next one.
first_line: Congrats on dosing the first MAX-001 participant. When you plan the chronic pain work, would love to be in the mix for EDC.

signal: Dosed the first participant in a 10-patient Phase 1/2 trial of OPGx-RDH12, its third gene therapy program in the clinic.
why_now: Several small trials at once. Small studies are where a lighter, faster EDC saves the most time.
first_line: Congrats on the third program reaching the clinic. Running several small trials at once is where a lighter EDC pays off.

signal: Dosed the first participant in EMERALD, a Phase 2 trial of its EO2002 cell therapy for corneal edema.
why_now: Phase 2 is underway, so planning for a bigger, later study usually starts soon. Worth an intro now so Harbor is in the mix for it.
first_line: Congrats on dosing the first EMERALD participant. When you plan the next study, would love to show how we run trials end to end.
